values.note: City of Lapeer rates as of July 1, 2025 (still posted in 2026): $35 a day, $200 a week, $525 a month; one rate for everyone (no resident rate). Dump station $10 and fresh-water refill $10 for non-campers. Card payments carry a 2.8% processing fee.

fees.source: https://www.ci.lapeer.mi.us/parks_and_recreation/water_tower_travel_trailer_park.php ('Rates as of July 1, 2025: Daily Rate: $35 Weekly Rate: $200 Monthly Rate: $525 Dump Station: $10 Fresh Water Refill: $10'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.ci.lapeer.mi.us/parks_and_recreation/water_tower_travel_trailer_park.php ('This 24 site park offers water, sewer, and electric on all of its pull through sites'), read 2026-10-22. No amperage stated.

sites.source: https://www.ci.lapeer.mi.us/parks_and_recreation/water_tower_travel_trailer_park.php ('This 24 site park offers water, sewer, and electric on all of its pull through sites'), read 2026-10-22. The city gives no length limit; the stored 50 ft came from note prose resting on directory listings and is cleared.

season.source: https://www.ci.lapeer.mi.us/parks_and_recreation/water_tower_travel_trailer_park.php ('The park is only open seasonally May 1st - October 31st'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.ci.lapeer.mi.us/parks_and_recreation/water_tower_travel_trailer_park.php ('Your pet is not allowed in the restroom or showers'; 'Dump Station: $10 Fresh Water Refill: $10'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Call the Water Tower RV Park to check availability (810) 664-4296.' 'Advance registrations are appreciated'; groups of 5 or more sites must reserve and prepay one night (non-refundable). All fees are paid at registration; office hours 9 a.m. - 6 p.m.

note: City of Lapeer Parks & Recreation RV park just north of downtown Lapeer, 3 miles north of the I-69/M-24 interchange; the city calls it 'not your typical campground', a stopover for business or pleasure travel. Walking path around a small pond with a fishing dock. No tent camping. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 24 pull-through full-hookup sites, May 1 - Oct 31, $35 a day (rates as of July 1, 2025, still posted), showers, dump and water fill, phone 810-664-4296 (matches). Booking recorded as phone (call for availability; reservations required only for 5+ sites). Cleared the directory-only 50-ft max. Note cleaned (hookups, rates, length and season now in fields).
